stats.title: Statistics
stats.credit_status_unsecured: Available credits are below one interval. Add funding to cover the first interval and start payouts.
stats.credit_status_fully_funded: Credits cover all expected intervals for the program.
stats.credit_status_healthy: Credits cover more than a few intervals, providing a healthy buffer.
stats.credit_status_low: Credits cover only a small number of intervals. Consider adding funding to improve the buffer.
stats.intervals_explanation: Available credits in CHF are succeeded contributions minus paid and confirmed payouts. Available intervals are available credits divided by cost per interval.
stats.total_contributions_explanation: Total contributions are the sum of contribution amounts in CHF where status is succeeded.
stats.total_program_cost_chf_explanation: Total program cost in CHF is paid out so far plus projected remaining payouts. Projected remaining uses active and future recipients and current program settings for duration, interval, and payout amount.
stats.paid_out_explanation: Paid out so far is the sum of payout amounts where status is paid or confirmed.
stats.total_program_cost_currency_explanation: Total program cost in program currency is paid out so far plus projected remaining payouts. Projected remaining uses current payout amount, interval, and expected intervals.
stats.contributors_explanation: Contributors is the distinct count of contributor identifiers across succeeded contributions.
stats.contributions_explanation: Contributions is the count of contribution records with succeeded status.
stats.average_contribution_explanation: Average contribution is total succeeded contributions in CHF divided by succeeded contributions count.
stats.stripe_explanation: Via Stripe is the CHF sum of succeeded contributions with payment event type stripe.
stats.wire_transfer_explanation: Via wire transfer is the CHF sum of succeeded contributions with payment event type bank transfer.
stats.other_contributions_explanation: Others is the CHF sum of succeeded contributions with payment event types other than stripe or bank transfer, including entries without a payment event.
stats.payout_per_interval_explanation: Payout per interval is the current payout amount configured for the program.
stats.payout_interval_explanation: Interval is the current payout cadence configured for the program.
stats.program_duration_explanation: Program duration is the currently configured runtime in months.
stats.cost_per_interval_explanation: Cost per interval is active recipients multiplied by payout per interval, shown in the program currency.
stats.projected_remaining_explanation: For each active or future recipient, remaining payouts are expected payouts minus already paid or confirmed payouts, with a minimum of zero. Projected remaining amount is remaining payouts multiplied by payout per interval, then summed.
stats.payouts_done_explanation: Payouts done counts all payout records, independent of payout status.
stats.remaining_payouts_explanation: Remaining payouts is the total number of payouts still expected for active and future recipients until completion.
stats.available_credits_explanation: Available credits in program currency are derived from available credits in CHF and converted with latest exchange rates.
stats.credit_status_explanation: Credit status is based on available intervals compared with status thresholds and expected intervals.
stats.remaining_intervals_explanation: Remaining intervals is the highest remaining interval count across active and future recipients.
stats.recipients_total_explanation: Recipients is the total number of recipients linked to this program.
stats.future_recipients_explanation: Future recipients have a start date in the future and are not yet payout eligible.
stats.active_recipients_explanation: Active recipients are started, not suspended, and not completed.
stats.suspended_recipients_explanation: Suspended recipients have a suspension date at or before now and are not counted as active.
stats.completed_recipients_explanation: Completed recipients have paid or confirmed payout count at least equal to expected intervals for the current program setup.
stats.completed_surveys_explanation: Completed surveys counts surveys with completed status.
stats.total_surveys_explanation: Total surveys counts all surveys linked to recipients in this program.
